description: Source code for creating ZIP archives within a Git-related project, including functions for writing ZIP entries, handling compression, and generating ZIP file structures.

methods.name: write_zip_entry
methods.description: Creates and writes a ZIP archive entry, handling compression, streaming, and ZIP structure details.

methods.name: write_zip_trailer
methods.description: Writes the ZIP file trailer and optional ZIP64 trailer.

methods.name: write_zip64_trailer
methods.description: Writes ZIP64 trailer and locator for large ZIP archives.

methods.name: archive_zip_config
methods.description: Configures ZIP archive options based on user settings.

methods.name: write_zip_archive
methods.description: Main function to write the entire ZIP archive, including entries and trailer.

methods.name: init_zip_archiver
methods.description: Registers the ZIP archiver with the system.
